name: Unreal Engine
description: Real-time 3D engine powering in-camera VFX (ICVFX), LED volume stages, MegaLights, and the open-source Lore VCS.
longDescription: Epic Games' Unreal Engine is the core technology powering modern virtual production stages around the world. UE 5.5 and 5.6 introduce production-ready MegaLights, Movie Render Graph, and Audio Insights, while Unreal Engine 6 targets Early Access in late 2027.

name: Topaz Video AI
description: AI video enhancement, temporal de-flickering, and Neurostream local consumer device inference.
longDescription: Topaz Video AI bridges the critical quality gap between synthetic generative video and professional 4K cinematography. Adobe announced an agreement to acquire Topaz Labs in June 2026, with the transaction pending regulatory approval.

name: Nuke
description: Industry-standard node-based compositing software featuring CopyCat machine learning used on Dune: Part Two.
longDescription: Foundry Nuke is the definitive node-based digital compositing application relied upon by the world's top studios. Powered 1,000 blue-eye shots on Dune: Part Two with its native CopyCat neural network toolset.

name: Blender
description: Open-source 3D creation suite with newly announced cloth physics in Geometry Nodes and major Cycles upgrades.
longDescription: Blender brings breakthrough cloth physics directly into procedural Geometry Nodes, alongside massive performance updates to Cycles rendering, making it a formidable alternative to proprietary packages.

name: DaVinci Resolve
description: Premier Hollywood color grading, editing, Fusion VFX, and Fairlight audio post-production suite.
longDescription: Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve combines neural isolation brushes, HDR Dolby Vision mastering, Fusion node VFX, and Cloud Multi-Seat Collaboration in both a free tier and professional Studio edition.

name: Houdini
description: Procedural 3D animation, physics simulation, and effects software dominating film pyro, fluid, and destruction.
longDescription: SideFX Houdini combines procedural node-based workflows with industry-leading simulation dynamics. From massive pyro explosions and oceanic water dynamics to complex crowd simulation.

name: Runway
description: Multimodal AI video generation platform with director controls, camera trajectories, and studio partnerships.
longDescription: Runway offers director-level camera controls, multi-character consistency, and cinematic framing through its Gen-3 Alpha Turbo architecture.

name: Adobe After Effects
description: Industry-standard motion graphics, title design, and visual effects compositing with native 3D workspace.
longDescription: Adobe After Effects is the essential motion design and visual effects software, featuring advanced 3D workspace integration, AI Roto Brush, and deep Creative Cloud pipeline hooks.

name: Autodesk Maya
description: Industry-standard 3D animation, rigging, character modeling, and simulation platform powering Hollywood feature animation.
longDescription: Autodesk Maya is the cornerstone 3D animation software relied on by leading VFX houses and animation studios worldwide, featuring native USD workflows and Bifrost visual programming.

name: Autodesk ShotGrid
description: Production tracking, review, and asset management software powering collaborative pipelines across global VFX facilities.
longDescription: Autodesk ShotGrid provides production management, review, and pipeline integration for creative studios worldwide, connecting artists, supervisors, and producers in real-time.

name: Higgsfield AI Video
description: Generative video platform with granular 3D camera trajectory controls and photorealistic human motion.
longDescription: Higgsfield AI is the generative video platform engineered for directors, previs artists, and cinematographers, offering granular 3D camera trajectory controls, realistic human motion kinematics, and custom scene direction.
features: Cinematic Pan, Tilt, Dolly & Boom Moves

name: ElevenLabs Cinema Voice AI
description: Hyper-realistic AI voice acting, automated dialogue replacement (ADR), and sound effects generation.
longDescription: ElevenLabs delivers studio-grade voice performances, automated dialogue replacement (ADR), and synthetic Foley sound effects with nuanced emotional control for cinema, gaming, and commercial localization.
